pr_title: Peek: icons, removed unneeded RTL code, ui tweaks and code suggestions
pr_body:
## Summary of the Pull Request

- Changed icon codes for the Pin button
- TitleBarHeightOption.Tall
- Removed a lot of unneeded RTL code
- Small tweaks in the Previewers (all subtle)
- Lots of suggestions by Visual Studio / Analyzer (functionally irrelevant)

## PR Checklist

- [x] Closes: #26134, #27261
- [x] Communication: I've discussed this with core contributors already. If work hasn't been agreed, this work might be rejected
- [ ] Documentation updated: If checked, please file a pull request on [our docs repo](https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/windows-uwp/tree/docs/hub/powertoys) and link it here: #xxx

## Validation Steps Performed

- Tested with Windows Language = Hebrew (RTL layout, which isn't applied by the Peek **window**, but content is alright)
- Double-checked light/dark theme switching and scaling

![image](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/assets/65828559/c82c3866-34c5-4d73-9415-d88e1ecc1c02)
> ↳ Drive, default size

![image](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/assets/65828559/1abca1bb-1a46-4358-8d32-7b34933c46da)
> ↳ Folder, minimum size

https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/assets/65828559/f3620acb-68cb-4a2b-8130-3ad60916d5b2
> ↳ Scrolling back and forth between 3 files (notice the bug)

![image](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/assets/65828559/db011288-24a5-4270-ac92-e449dd11eb2d)
> ↳ RTL OS (notice the window title bar doesn't change)

FYI @SamChaps
pr_comments: Before vs after screenshots for the relevant changes would be great!
Question: why does the layout of the ~TitleBar~ **window** buttons not change when OS is using a RTL language? Is it a bug of WinuiEx?

> Question: why does the layout of the TitleBar buttons not change when OS is using a RTL language? Is it a bug of WinuiEx?

Don't know this. But I have in mind that there was a PR in the past to add workaround code.
@SamChaps would you like to review this too?

@jay-o-way Not part if this PR, but the pin and 'open with' buttons in the titlebar look awkward due to the vertical alignment of the window caption buttons.

We might be able to improve this though, by setting the `PreferredHeightOption` to `TitleBarHeightOption.Tall` (see https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/develop/title-bar#tall-title-bar-support-for-custom-title-bars)

Default vs. Tall
![image](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/assets/9866362/b0e15120-f025-47d0-a295-4a6ac648abb6)

We probably want to do that with the PT Settings titlebar as well

>  do that with the PT Settings titlebar as well

Great idea. Easy to add. But the WCT TitleBar will also deal with this. So, we _could_ also choose to wait for that. That will also deal with the text color for active/inactive window, which is very difficult to do as it is now - for Peek.

Weird, this PR contains changes for Registry Preview? I'll merge main in first to see if that goes away from Files changed. I assume that happened because this work was started on top of a reviewed PR.
That's from an older commit/pr which is already in main. It must have been merged into main right after I started with this.

> That's from an older commit/pr which is already in main?

Yes, this commit: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/32087/commits/1e29556d956759065434696ac96a3c7464096366

But the merge seems to have removed those changes, so I think we're good. I'll merge after CI passes.

Thank you for the contribution.

issue_context.title: Peek: wrong icons used to pin/unpin
issue_context.body:
### Microsoft PowerToys version

0.70

### Installation method

PowerToys auto-update

### Running as admin

No

### Area(s) with issue?

General

### Steps to reproduce

Open something with Peek. Look ar pin/unpin icons

### ✔️ Expected Behavior

_No response_

### ❌ Actual Behavior

The icon/button that you click to **pin** is the strike-though icon. `E718` should be used here.
The icon/button that you click to **unpin** is only a fill icon, designed to be able to set a fill color. `E77A` should be used here.
![image](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/assets/65828559/8f00b4da-f2fa-48f3-b3ab-c17b065bc447)


### Other Software

_No response_
comments:
Current logic does the following in TitleBar.xaml.cs:
`return pinned ? "\xE841" : "\xE77A";`
Should be a simple fix.

review_comments: nit: it's a a bit more readable when the null returned value is last in the ternary operator
